answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the spiral queue naming the voyage that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 6 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Because of that, every alias costs 6 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the signal record shows exactly who is still on probation.
